_comment: Authoring fixture for tests/import.test.js. Twelve solved harvest records, shaped like .harvest/vendored.json entries with the browser verdict folded in. It deliberately contains one dead game, two repos that produce the same normalised title, and a family (tetris) with more members than the tests' capPerFamily of 3.

entries.title: Block Drop
entries.description: A falling-block puzzle game with a clean canvas renderer.

entries.title: Tetris JS
entries.description: The classic tetromino stacker, written in plain JavaScript.

entries.title: Block Drop
entries.description: Another falling-block game, this one with a different colour palette and a much longer description than the original Block Drop so the enrichment tiebreak has something to weigh.

entries.title: Tetromino
entries.description: Seven shapes, one well, endless blocks.

entries.title: Stack Attack
entries.description: A stacker that plays more like a falling-block puzzle than a tower builder.

entries.title: Snake
entries.description: Eat, grow, do not bite yourself.

entries.title: Snake Reloaded
entries.description: The snake game again, with neon colours and sound.

entries.title: Sudoku
entries.description: A grid of numbers that wants filling.

entries.title: 2048 Merge
entries.description: Slide tiles, merge twos, chase the 2048 tile.

entries.title: Neon Racer
entries.description: A top-down racer that never ends.

entries.title: Broken Game
entries.description: This one loads nothing at all - the canvas never paints and its main script 404s.
entries.reason: 1 missing script or stylesheet; nothing playable
